result.instructions: Tools for Ticketsauce, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my events start this weekend, and how many tickets has each sold?"; "List the orders for my next event placed in the last 24 hours."; "Find the order for jane@example.com on the Summer Fest event and show her tickets.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Ticketsauce data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run ticketsauce_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run ticketsauce_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run ticketsauce_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. ticketsauce_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: ticketsauce_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List the events you own on Ticketsauce with id, name, slug, start/end (local and UTC), venue address, timezone, organization, privacy type, whether tickets are on sale, and the event and ticket-shop URLs. Filter by start/end/created dates (yyyy-mm-dd, UTC), a phrase such as this_weekend, organization or partner. The API has no paging for events. Use the event id for orders and check-ins. GET /v2/events.

start_after.description: Events starting on/after this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

start_before.description: Events starting on/before this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

start_phrase.description: Events starting in a named period (today, this_weekend, next_month...).

end_after.description: Events ending on/after this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

end_before.description: Events ending on/before this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

created_after.description: Events created on/after this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

created_before.description: Events created on/before this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

active_only.description: Only active events (the API default is true).

inactive_only.description: Only inactive events (the API default is false).

include_performers.description: Include the performers of each event.

tools.name: ticketsauce_get_event
tools.title: Get event
tools.description: One event by id or slug: everything in the list plus summary and description (text and HTML), order_count and ticket_count (tickets sold, not refunded or voided). Replies are cached for an hour. GET /v2/event/{id_or_slug}.

event.description: Event id (UUID) or event slug, as returned by ticketsauce_list_events.

tools.name: ticketsauce_list_orders
tools.title: List orders of an event
tools.description: Orders of one event, oldest first by default (pass sort_dir desc for newest first): order id, status, buyer name, email, phone and address, totals (total_paid, refund_amount, taxes, fees), promo code, ticket_count, paid date. Contains your customers' personal data. Filter by order or modified dates, a phrase, buyer email or last name (exact match), totals, or promo use; optionally embed tickets, questionnaire answers and line-item fees. Paged: per_page up to 500, then pass next_page. Replies are cached for an hour. GET /v2/orders/{event_id}.

q.description: Exact buyer email address or last name.

total_above.description: Only orders with a total greater than this.

total_below.description: Only orders with a total less than this.

promo_used_only.description: Only orders that used a promo code.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: ticketsauce_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: One order by id, with its buyer details, totals and its tickets (ticket type, name, price, redeemed state, promo code). Contains personal data. Replies are cached for an hour. GET /v2/order/{order_id}.

tools.name: ticketsauce_list_checkin_ids
tools.title: List ticket check-in ids
tools.description: The ticket check-in ids of one event, for door/scanning reconciliation (the API documents no response fields; the reply is returned as is). Paged: per_page up to 5000, then pass next_page. Replies are cached for 5 minutes. GET /v2/tickets/checkin_ids/{event_id}.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.
